انقضيا (form VII)
# اِنْقَضَيَا (inqaḍayā) /in.qa.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْقَضَى (inqaḍā)
# اِنْقَضِيَا (inqaḍiyā) /in.qa.dˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْقَضَى (inqaḍā)
